🎮 Arcade Forge — templates and AI generation

Full arcade games. Templates offline. Custom games with AI.

Play Pac-Man, Space Invaders, Snake and the other listed templates offline. Custom games and gameplay revisions require a capable on-device or online model. Auto may use online generation; enable Local Mode to keep generation on your device.

Source workshop · supported MIT 2048 adapter

Acquire four pinned files from Gabriele Cirulli’s official repository. Modify initial tiles or the actual spawning rule, verify in Chromium, then save/reopen an immutable game. Board progress is memory-o
